gold_steps: Shut off the water supply to the toilet.
Remove the tank lid and inspect the flapper and chain.

Reconnect the chain with proper slack.
Turn water on and test flush to ensure toilet stops running.

gold_steps: Avoid flushing again to prevent overflow.

user_scenario: My bathroom sink drains slowly and gets backed up

gold_diagnosis.label: Hair/soap clog in sink drain trap

gold_steps: Remove the sink stopper or strainer from the drain opening.
Use a hair clog tool or needle-nose pliers to pull out hair and gunk.
Place a bucket under the P-trap pipe beneath the sink.
Loosen the nuts and remove the P-trap to clear out debris.
Clean the trap and drain pipe thoroughly.
Reinstall the trap, tighten fittings, and run water to test flow.
